text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the spring Tenno Sho. Expectations are high for Mejiro Palmer, Ikuno Dictus, Mejiro McQueen, and Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And thanks to word of her performance at the Diamond Stakes, expectations are high for Matikanetannhauser as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sparks fly as all these talented Umamusume face off, and the spring Tenno Sho begins!
